title: Japanese Yakitori Sausage Skewers
description: A simple and flavorful Japanese-inspired recipe featuring chicken sausage and kissed umami flavors.

ingredients.name: Kissed
ingredients.notes: Sesame oil with a hint of garlic

ingredients.name: Skewers
ingredients.notes: Sized for small pieces of sausage

instructions: Thread sausage pieces onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
In a small bowl, whisk together kissed, umami, salt, and pepper.
Brush the mixture onto both sides of the sausage.
Grill skewers for 8-10 minutes, turning occasionally.
Serve immediately, garnished with green onions and sesame seeds.
